commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED_HEAD=157806442161e88edd8038e532e9dff333a19efb; PREFLIGHT_HEAD=231eed28f64bdbdc4238fd8bce128264027702f2; QUALIFIED=5a4830db9d10e8cb73d4c617b09122f0844ad899; git fetch -q origin --prune; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess
expected_head='157806442161e88edd8038e532e9dff333a19efb'
preflight='231eed28f64bdbdc4238fd8bce128264027702f2'
qualified='5a4830db9d10e8cb73d4c617b09122f0844ad899'
post=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',f'{preflight}..{expected_head}'],text=True).splitlines())
expected_docs={'docs/CONTINUATION_PLAN.md','docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md','docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_H_HANDOFF.md'}
assert post == expected_docs,(post,expected_docs)
prod=[p for p in subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',f'{qualified}..{expected_head}'],text=True).splitlines() if p.endswith(('.c','.cc','.cpp','.h','.hpp'))]
assert not prod,prod
active=['AGENTS.md','docs/GUIDANCE.md','docs/PROJECT_ROADMAP.md','docs/STAGE28D_AH_ARBITER_HANDOFF.md','docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_H_HANDOFF.md','docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md','docs/CONTINUATION_PLAN.md']
text='\n'.join(open(p).read() for p in active)
assert 'resources: ["board:growbox-s3"]' not in text
assert '`board:growbox-s3`' not in text
assert 'resources: []' in text
asset=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/20260908-stage28e-h-v8-prepared.json'],text=True))
assert asset['status']=='prepared_not_queued'
assert asset['expected_head']==expected_head
assert asset['resources']==[]
assert asset['start_condition']=='explicit_user_authorization_only'
missing=subprocess.run(['git','cat-file','-e','origin/agent-control:.agent/tasks/20260908-stage28e-h-v8-timeroff-observer-v1.json'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).returncode
assert missing != 0,'H v8 hardware task is unexpectedly queued'
heads=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-remote','--heads','origin'],text=True).splitlines()
branches={line.split('refs/heads/',1)[1] for line in heads}
allowed={'agent-control','gh-pages','main','mvp/environment-controller'}
assert branches==allowed,(branches,allowed)
print('H_V8_FINAL_READINESS_PASS', 'head='+expected_head, 'preflight='+preflight, 'resources=empty', 'hardware_task_queued=0', 'remote_branches='+','.join(sorted(branches)))
PY
git diff --check; echo H_V8_READY_NOT_STARTED_PASS
